name: fraud-detection-demo
description: Explainable fraud detection on imbalanced synthetic data: a hybrid of XGBoost and Isolation Forest (PR-AUC ≈ 0.82) with SHAP explanations for every decision. Includes a Streamlit risk console, a FastAPI REST API, pytest tests and a Dockerfile.

paragraphs: A hybrid fraud detection system that combines a supervised XGBoost classifier with an unsupervised Isolation Forest, evaluated with PR-AUC on a realistically imbalanced dataset and explained transaction by transaction with SHAP.
features: Realistic class imbalance — 1.5% fraud, evaluated with PR-AUC rather than ROC-AUC, which looks inflated when true negatives dominate.
Hybrid modeling — XGBoost learns known fraud patterns from labels; an Isolation Forest trained only on legitimate transactions flags statistically unusual behavior without needing labels.
Per-transaction explanations — a SHAP waterfall plot shows which factors pushed each individual decision toward fraud or legitimate.
Interpretable features — amount, time, distance and velocity signals with real meaning, instead of anonymized PCA components.
REST API + Docker — a FastAPI service serves the full hybrid score with SHAP explanations, ships as a Docker image, and is tested to reproduce the offline evaluation exactly.
